name: forge
description: Adversarial brainstorming engine for Claude Code. Runs ideas through parallel Builder, Critic, and User Advocate subagents to surface weaknesses before a sprint begins.

commands.name: forge
commands.description: Adversarial brainstorming — runs an idea through Builder, Critic, and User Advocate subagents in parallel and produces a structured IdeaReport with confidence score

commands.name: forge-ship
commands.description: Ships the active IdeaReport to Jira as a ticket and clears the session

agents.name: forge-builder
agents.description: Builder subagent — extends ideas, surfaces non-obvious angles, estimates effort

agents.name: forge-critic
agents.description: Critic subagent — finds weaknesses, risks, and failure modes; labels each [blocking] or [resolvable]

agents.name: forge-user-advocate
agents.description: User Advocate subagent — challenges ideas from the end user's perspective

skills.name: feature-brainstorm
skills.description: Technical feature evaluation: feasibility, sprint estimation, performance and security risks, user adoption

skills.name: general-brainstorm
skills.description: Domain-agnostic evaluation: business strategy, market fit, incentive alignment, adoption

hooks.description: Prints a Forge ready message at the start of each Claude Code session
After forge_create_ticket runs, prompts the user to record the output in evals/results/ for regression tracking

mcp_prerequisites.name: atlassian
mcp_prerequisites.description: Atlassian's official remote MCP server. Required for /forge ship. Connect once via browser OAuth — no API tokens or local build needed.

eval_command: cd evals && npm install && npx ts-node runner.ts
